overview.title: Reactive Dialogue
overview.body: §7Villagers react to nearby mobs, blocks, player actions, trading, damage and plenty more. Try doing things around them and listen for a response.

overview.title: Animations

overview.title: Conversations

overview.title: Reaction Categories

overview.title: Player Reputation
overview.body: §7Villagers remember how you treat them. Trading and curing Villagers improve your reputation, while hurting or killing them lowers it. Villagers will even gossip about you with each other, changing how they react to you.

overview.title: Special Villagers
overview.body: §7One of each special Villager News character spawns in your world. Explore different Villages to find them and trade for their unique items.

generalInformation.title: Triggers & Reactions
generalInformation.body: §7Triggers are actions, events or situations Villagers can notice. Reactions are the dialogue and animations they may respond with.

generalInformation.title: Nearby & Visible
generalInformation.body: §7Most reactions require a Villager to be nearby or able to see what is happening. Different triggers can have different detection requirements.

generalInformation.title: Cooldowns
generalInformation.body: §7Reactions use cooldowns to keep dialogue feeling natural. Repeating the same or similar actions may not trigger another reaction immediately.

generalInformation.title: No Reaction?
generalInformation.body: §7Not every trigger will cause a Villager to react every time. Cooldowns, distance, visibility, context and Chattiness can all affect whether a reaction plays.

generalInformation.title: Context Matters
generalInformation.body: §7Some reactions depend on additional conditions such as the Villager's profession, age, surroundings, your reputation or what is happening nearby.

generalInformation.title: Reaction Variations
generalInformation.body: §7Many triggers have multiple possible reactions, so Villagers won't always respond to the same situation in exactly the same way.

generalInformation.title: Chattiness
generalInformation.body: §7Villager Chattiness controls how frequently Villagers speak. Lower settings make reactions less frequent, while higher settings make Villagers more talkative.

generalInformation.title: Rare Lines
generalInformation.body: §7Some reactions include longer and more unusual Rare Lines. Their frequency can be adjusted separately using Rare Villager Lines in Settings.
